reserves.name: Re7-managed DeFi yield strategy NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Re7 Capital strategy manager and Midas issuer

sources.label: Midas mRe7YIELD weekly report dated September 10, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: mRe7YIELD tracks a Re7 Capital managed DeFi yield strategy. The issuer-prepared September 10 weekly report provides aggregate assets and liabilities and three collateral categories, but approximately 98.29% of reported assets remains grouped as Market Neutral Strategy. Settlement categories do not identify their assets or custodians. This is current aggregate reporting, not complete look-through or independent assurance; the NAV envelope remains unresolved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Midas product, risk, and attestation disclosures; live NAV row identity from the Midas Chainlink NAV oracle adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The September 10 issuer report discloses aggregate strategy and settlement categories, but underlying strategy positions, liabilities, venue weights and settlement-asset custody remain unverified. Its broad categories do not provide a complete classified portfolio.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The current issuer report groups most assets as Market Neutral Strategy and does not identify settlement assets or custodians; complete underlying dependencies and weights remain unresolved.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Fordefi documents dedicated Midas workspaces in which the strategy manager holds an MPC share and Midas holds an administrative policy share. Assets are actively deployed across protocols and venues, so provider allocation, venue segregation, and reuse conditions remain strategy-dependent.
